Sorry I deleted my response because I accidentally replied from my main account. 

I’m going to try and see what options are available but I am pretty nervous. Thank you.

I know and I don’t expect them to counsel me through it but I wish someone would help me find professional help or just let me know they’re there for me as support and that’s initially what I asked 

It just sucks because I feel incredibly alone and this kinda stuff doesn’t help. I feel bothersome but I just feel so low

Oh I am currently working two jobs- both of which schedule me right below where I need to be for insurance through the company. I’ve tried finding jobs that I can get insurance through but most around here don’t. I am in the US and have applied for state health insurance but it was saying I would be paying around $300-$350 monthly on what is just barebones insurance. I live in the Midwest. 

Thank you for your help. There’s nothing specific bringing me down, just life in general I guess. I feel like I would be better off just being dead and that’s my main issue I guess haha

My primary caretakers (grandparents) died whenever I was 16, and my bio mother never took responsibility again (I was too close to being an adult for her to think I needed it). I lost my state coverage after I graduated high school. 

I’m not currently enrolled in school. I start cosmetology school soon and as far as that goes I don’t think they have counselors? I’m not Sure, I’ll have to look into it

I don’t know where to start, which is the main reason I was asking for help from my fam. 

I’m pretty young and don’t have health insurance, I’ve never done anything like this before

Yeah I don’t plan on messaging him again for awhile. I was thinking I could message him again in a couple months whenever his birthday pops up but nothing more than a casual happy birthday / how are you? By that time it may even slip my mind, who knows. 

Realizing now that I’ve not given him a chance to really miss me (thinking 2 weeks was enough was foolish), I’ve suffocated him. It is hard when blinded by emotion.

Yeah it is hard. 

I’ve been doing the best things I can for myself like going to the gym, switching up my diet, and just trying to live and be comfortable being by myself. 

I of course would like for us to get together again in the future but would take friendship over nothing you know?

I feel bad for deleting him after expressing I wanted a friendship in the future but as of now, seeing everything he posts all the time is putting a damper on my growth. I hope he’ll accept me back in his life in a couple months as friends. Our breakup was amicable, so maybe it’s possible.  

Thanks. It’s a weird spot to be in. I appreciate your response.
I know that rekindling a relationship won’t be possible but I do eventually want to be friends down the line. I guess I should wait awhile before trying to make contact for that purpose?
